stem: Which line from the play supports the idea that Marcus has changed the way he feels about having a female player on the team?

options.label: A
options.text: MARCUS: I guess we can try it, but this kid had better be good.

options.label: C
options.text: MARCUS: I can’t believe Sam won.

options.label: D
options.text: MARCUS: Hey, Carter, does she have a sister in town?
